events.handoff: Record a new lesson learned about the appointment status state machine in project storage. Do not look up or read existing lessons first; draft the new lesson directly.

output_document.summary: Lesson: the status state machine is enforced only on PATCH /appointments/<id>/status, so every other route that sets a status, and every field tied to a transition, must respect it. Drawn from this work: (1) a repeat status change must stay a no-op, so re-cancelling must leave the stored cancellation_reason alone; (2) cancellation saving the reason alongside the status broke a test that expected every status change to save the same thing; (3) the create route accepts a finished status (cancelled/completed), skipping the transition rules. How to apply: list every status-writing route and transition-tied field before changing status behavior, save those fields only when the status actually changes, and check for tests that assume every status change saves the same thing.
